title: sclarea pratensis
intro: Sclarea pratensis, commonly known as clary sage, is a flowering plant in the mint family. It is valued for its health benefits, including reducing anxiety and promoting relaxation due to its calming effects. Clary sage's therapeutic actions include acting as an antispasmodic, analgesic, and anti-inflammatory, making it useful in treating muscle and joint pain. The bioactive constituents of clary sage include linalool, linalyl acetate, and sclareol, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
